body:
## Pull request overview

Migrates the Turso/libSQL driver into this monorepo as a first-class plugin that extends the existing Knex-based `SqlDriver`, plus adds a multi-tenant router and updates project docs/changelog/roadmap accordingly.

**Changes:**
- Added new `@objectstack/driver-turso` plugin package with `TursoDriver`, multi-tenant router, exports, README, and tests.
- Refactored `@objectstack/driver-sql` internals from `private` → `protected` to support subclassing, and fixed `count()` zero-handling (`||` → `??`).
- Updated lockfile and project docs (CHANGELOG/ROADMAP) to reflect the new driver/plugin.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds `@libsql/client` and related transitive deps for the new Turso driver package. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/tsconfig.json | Adds package TS config (aligned with other plugins). |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts | Implements `TursoDriver` extending `SqlDriver` with optional libsql sync lifecycle. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.test.ts | Adds Turso driver integration tests over in-memory SQLite. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/multi-tenant.ts | Adds TTL-cached per-tenant driver router. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/multi-tenant.test.ts | Adds router tests (creation/caching/CRUD/callbacks). |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/index.ts | Exports driver/router/factory and provides default plugin manifest. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/package.json | Introduces new plugin package metadata and dependencies. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/README.md | Documents architecture, connection modes, multi-tenant usage, and plugin registration. |
| packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts | Enables subclass extensibility (protected members) and fixes `count()` for zero results. |
| ROADMAP.md | Lists SQL + Turso drivers as shipped components. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Records Turso driver addition, SQL driver extensibility change, and `count()` fix. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`toKnexConfig()` silently falls back to `:memory:` for remote-only URLs (`libsql://`/`https://`). This makes `TursoDriver` appear to work but all CRUD hits an in-memory SQLite DB and nothing is persisted to the remote Turso database (high risk of data loss). Consider either (a) implementing remote execution via `@libsql/client` for remote-only mode, or (b) throwing a clear error in `connect()` when `url` is remote and `syncUrl` is not provided, so the unsupported mode can't be used accidentally.

`encryptionKey`, `concurrency`, and `timeout` are exposed on `TursoDriverConfig`, but in local/in-memory modes (no `syncUrl`) they are never applied because the driver only uses Knex/better-sqlite3. This can mislead callers into thinking encryption/limits/timeouts are active when they're ignored. Either validate these options (e.g., require `syncUrl`/libsql mode) or document/implement their behavior for the Knex path.

`createMultiTenantRouter()` does not guard against concurrent `getDriverForTenant()` calls for the same tenant. Two overlapping calls can create/connect two drivers, with the later one overwriting the cache entry and the earlier one leaking an open connection. Consider storing an in-flight Promise per tenant (or a simple per-tenant mutex) so concurrent calls share the same creation/connect work and only one driver instance is created.

`driverConfigOverrides.syncUrl` can contain a `{tenant}` placeholder (the README example uses this), but only `urlTemplate` is interpolated. As written, `syncUrl` will be passed through literally and embedded-replica sync will fail. Consider applying the same `{tenant}` replacement to `syncUrl` (and any other templated string fields you intend to support) when building `driverConfig`.

The tests hardcode `/tmp/...` paths in `urlTemplate`. This will fail on Windows runners and can also collide across parallel test runs. Prefer using `node:os` `tmpdir()` + `node:path` to build a per-test temporary directory/file (and clean it up), or use Vitest's temp facilities if available.

`better-sqlite3` is required at runtime because `TursoDriver` always instantiates Knex with `client: 'better-sqlite3'`, but it is listed under `devDependencies`. Consumers installing `@objectstack/driver-turso` won't get `better-sqlite3` installed, causing runtime failures. Move it to `dependencies` (or declare it as a `peerDependency` and document the requirement).
```suggestion
    "nanoid": "^3.3.11",
    "better-sqlite3": "^11.9.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^25.5.0",
```

The README shows `driverConfigOverrides.syncUrl: 'libsql://{tenant}-myorg.turso.io'`, but the router currently only interpolates `{tenant}` in `urlTemplate`, not in `syncUrl`. Either update the README example or implement placeholder replacement for `syncUrl` so the documented configuration works.

The README describes a "Remote (Cloud)" connection mode (`url: 'libsql://...'`), but the current implementation falls back to an in-memory SQLite backend for remote-only URLs and does not execute queries against the remote Turso database unless `syncUrl` is configured. Please either implement true remote mode via `@libsql/client` or remove/clarify the remote-mode documentation to avoid users believing their data is persisted remotely when it isn't.
```suggestion
 * Supports the following connection modes:
 * 1. **Local (Embedded):** `url: 'file:./data/local.db'`
 * 2. **In-memory (Ephemeral):** `url: ':memory:'`
 * 3. **Embedded Replica (Hybrid):** `url` (local file or `:memory:`) +
 *    `syncUrl` (remote `libsql://` / `https://` Turso endpoint)
 *
 * In all modes, the primary query engine runs against a local SQLite
 * database (via SqlDriver). In embedded replica mode, `syncUrl` and
 * `authToken` configure synchronization with a remote Turso database;
 * a bare `url: 'libsql://...'` remote-only connection is not supported
 * by this driver and will not persist data remotely.
 */
export interface TursoDriverConfig {
  /** Database URL for the local store (`file:` or `:memory:`) */
  url: string;

  /** JWT auth token for remote Turso database (used with `syncUrl`) */
```
